stem.en: In most programming languages, what does the statement x = x + 1 mean?
stem.et: Mida tähendab enamikus programmeerimiskeeltes lause x = x + 1?

label.en: Compute x + 1 and store the result back in x — assignment, not an equation
label.et: Arvuta x + 1 ja salvesta tulemus tagasi x-i — see on omistamine, mitte võrrand

label.en: An equation with no solution, so it is an error
label.et: Võrrand, millel ei ole lahendit, seega on tegu veaga

label.en: The same thing in every language, since algorithms and programs are identical
label.et: Igas keeles sama, sest algoritmid ja programmid on identsed

label.en: Nothing, unless the program produces an error message
label.et: Mitte midagi, kui programm ei anna veateadet
